A hangover kit is ` [Highlight start] a pre-packed or DIY recovery bundle [Highlight end] ` —typically costing around **$2 to $56** —designed to ease headaches, dehydration, and fatigue after a night out.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF14aD-A9BkcKF64aRmLLREE5vN93vJdM142tM1aQeHbpnEcg0cay-z9TraB4oogHMa-uRdBZpi1qoB26G9vUQZE-rQP4TeskcvaC3tcF0aYcfOxEpyPvmzC7RCE4pjPfN527icfccYFiy0QWONuUnOE-d2XOl511XLQmlUUJTXL2pfsGHVD8gfFs)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXF8DJzOlkTDp-cDqD2SKZaSmOQqWzhQMHTyGGGrMsw6i1tSugkH3ykVH9yJaqMy64F-6Rc2Z5RnV2r7AjQKtRKWtVrIFzxqQQEkqfAZoWNY4YcxHmhvriVKqeu_ccHVI)

### Common Items Inside

- **Hydration & energy:** Electrolyte drink packets, hydration tablets, energy tea, or instant coffee.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF14aD-A9BkcKF64aRmLLREE5vN93vJdM142tM1aQeHbpnEcg0cay-z9TraB4oogHMa-uRdBZpi1qoB26G9vUQZE-rQP4TeskcvaC3tcF0aYcfOxEpyPvmzC7RCE4pjPfN527icfccYFiy0QWONuUnOE-d2XOl511XLQmlUUJTXL2pfsGHVD8gfFs)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXMdvA3vekTBDSjn3iyaNo3TUn2b62MgIuwM7LWwJoQCxcAU6QnIIUsi9N2S1rfJ2U_xt-C0-VJdZ8slZreudN6CVMLBSKqP48t_1eteowrCRQR0wotmcmwcmxxHxT)
- **Symptom relief:** Pain relievers (like aspirin or ibuprofen), antacids, ginger chews, or upset-stomach tablets.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXWqT1JrrYchdUkihs5a90Ml5nZxA9ab7lMxziXbUBPbfA7MW5fNsABxtoJHi0dPqvx8ZNmdGrllWJFwQ9CUfYh-1RKZyQmuJ8og8cI8XIeOLYDmYl4RkSMtMZUN9UrLi3tEGzDejMn6Q)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14908517454347185223,catalogid:417613129673731092,gpcid:16456074013653509517,mid:576462657646110170&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXMdvA3vekTBDSjn3iyaNo3TUn2b62MgIuwM7LWwJoQCxcAU6QnIIUsi9N2S1rfJ2U_xt-C0-VJdZ8slZreudN6CVMLBSKqP48t_1eteowrCRQR0wotmcmwcmxxHxT)
- **Rest & comfort:** Eye masks, earplugs, lip balm, and cooling gel masks.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:6075837511713281262,catalogid:7305746779446795880,gpcid:12614499951534594945,mid:576462915539459684&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:16608910387829912140,catalogid:805470702040156677,gpcid:134584016944005395,mid:576462840588607488&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXMdvA3vekTBDSjn3iyaNo3TUn2b62MgIuwM7LWwJoQCxcAU6QnIIUsi9N2S1rfJ2U_xt-C0-VJdZ8slZreudN6CVMLBSKqP48t_1eteowrCRQR0wotmcmwcmxxHxT)
- **Fresh-up basics:** Face or makeup wipes, mints or breath strips, mouthwash, hand sanitizer, and Band-Aids.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF14aD-A9BkcKF64aRmLLREE5vN93vJdM142tM1aQeHbpnEcg0cay-z9TraB4oogHMa-uRdBZpi1qoB26G9vUQZE-rQP4TeskcvaC3tcF0aYcfOxEpyPvmzC7RCE4pjPfN527icfccYFiy0QWONuUnOE-d2XOl511XLQmlUUJTXL2pfsGHVD8gfFs)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:6075837511713281262,catalogid:7305746779446795880,gpcid:12614499951534594945,mid:576462915539459684&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:14908517454347185223,catalogid:417613129673731092,gpcid:16456074013653509517,mid:576462657646110170&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXMdvA3vekTBDSjn3iyaNo3TUn2b62MgIuwM7LWwJoQCxcAU6QnIIUsi9N2S1rfJ2U_xt-C0-VJdZ8slZreudN6CVMLBSKqP48t_1eteowrCRQR0wotmcmwcmxxHxT)
